usage: The word 總站 (zung2 zaam6) refers to the final stop or terminus of a bus, train, or other public transport route.
It is used as a noun and usually comes after the transport type or route number to specify the end of the line.
When giving directions or explaining transport routes, 總站 helps identify where the vehicle stops last.
You can also use 總站 to ask if a bus or train goes all the way to the final stop.
